positive_claims: observed GnuCOBOL CALL / linkage / C$ extension behavior under the gnucobol-3.2.0-default witness, verified by the sweep (5/0) -- the #1 gap by frequency (CALL 959x in the admitted testsuite per GNURUST.PUBLIC.GAP.1): USING BY REFERENCE SHARES the caller's storage so callee mutation is visible in the caller (A 100 -> 101), USING BY CONTENT passes a COPY so the caller is UNCHANGED (B stays 100), a C$ extension (C$TOUPPER) mutates in place, an unresolved CALL fires ON EXCEPTION gracefully, and CANCEL unloads.
